mapper.select: SELECT public_id,title,created_at,updated_at FROM chat_session WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT public_id,title,created_at,updated_at FROM chat_session WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id FROM chat_session WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT public_id,role,content,intent,CAST(metadata AS CHAR) metadata_json,created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT public_id,role,content,intent,CAST(metadata AS CHAR) metadata_json,created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}
SELECT status,user_message_id,assistant_message_id,updated_at FROM chat_request WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_request SET user_message_id=#{userMessageId} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} AND user_message_id IS NULL
UPDATE chat_request SET status='COMPLETED',assistant_message_id=#{assistantMessageId},error_code=NULL WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE chat_request SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} AND status='PROCESSING'
